verdict.rationale: Vue's official store ecosystem gives a path to explicit, traceable state flow: a user calls Vuex 'one of the cleanest flux implementation[s]', and Pinia appears in the docs. But a hands-on report says Vue's two-way binding causes confusion about where state lives and 'implicit state changes wrecking havoc', and another user calls it too 'magical' for complex apps. That is the very debugging pain the story wants to avoid. missing for 10: first-party documentation of one-way data flow or prop/emit conventions, evidence of devtools-based state-change tracing, Pinia content beyond a title, and evidence that two-way binding pitfalls are mitigated.
